title: About
text:
This site is a compact portfolio of my research, teaching, and applied data work.
It brings together:

recent research and collaboration highlights
teaching materials and course notes
project writeups and links to related repositories
a current CV for quick reference

The goal is to keep the site easy to scan while still showing the breadth of my work across analytics, engineering, and applied research.

Research Projects and Collaborations

Python implementation of bolasso: (in progress, 12/2024) Combining aspects of fastFeatures, bolasso, and research from several authors to build a robust bootstrap lasso package for the modern data science and statistical environment.

Collaborators:

Daniel Molitor
Daniel Eubanks


fastFeatures is an R package built from the ground up with one goal in mind: High-speed variable selection in typical statistical/data science settings so that you may (and shall) build a predictive model that is easy to explain and share.

Collaborators:

Carson Sprock


TidyAgronomy is the first “tidyverse” R Package to unify the data and model framework of commonly used features for agronomic data science at scale.

Collaborators:

Lucky Mehra
Paul Tanger
Mohammad Bannayan

title: James Horine
text:
I am a second-year D.Eng student at Penn State’s School of Engineering Design and Innovation, with research focused on engineered systems for simulating and evaluating market and non-market economic impacts.
I currently work in Applied Sciences (Data Science) at Bayer and bring more than 10 years of experience across agriculture, aviation, consulting, analytics, and applied R&D.
This site highlights my current research, teaching materials, and selected projects.
